privacy_intro_content: We care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when using our app.
privacy_data_content:
We may collect the following information:
• Personal Information: Name, Email, Phone Number.
• Usage Data: Your interactions with the app, products you view.
• Device Information: Device type, operating system.
privacy_usage_content:
We use your data for the following purposes:
• Improving user experience and providing personalized services.
• Processing orders and managing your account.
• Communicating with you regarding updates and offers.
privacy_sharing_content: We do not sell your data to third parties. We may only share your data with trusted service providers who assist us in operating the app (such as payment and shipping services), in compliance with applicable laws.
privacy_security_content: We take appropriate security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy_deletion_content: You have the right to request the deletion of your account and personal data at any time through the app settings or by contacting support.
terms_intro_content: Welcome to our app. By using this app, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions. Please read these terms carefully before starting to use the app.
terms_account_content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account data, including your password, and you are fully responsible for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
terms_usage_content: The app must be used for lawful purposes only. It is prohibited to use the app for any illegal or harmful activity, or to attempt to hack the app or access other users' data.
terms_payment_content: All purchases made through the app are subject to our payment and refund policy. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order for any reason, including product availability or pricing errors.
terms_ip_content: All intellectual property rights related to the app, its logo, design, and content belong to us. No part of the content may be copied, distributed, or reproduced without prior written permission.
terms_changes_content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be posted on this page, and your continued use of the app after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of these modifications.
